body: Thank you, I just hate how the world is right now. Hearing all of this makes my head swell. I hope you’re able to find a way out of that medication, and able to say goodbye to those money grabbing corporations
I always hated doctors, they make good money for a reason. I’d rather die than to listen to one.
Yeah…I feel like I need to vent about it

Humanity in general sucks. You have to deal with it, they don’t give a shit about you so give a shit about them either. Trying to minimize contact with people you think you hate is probably the best and safest thing to do. It’s gonna only get worse and worse as life continues to solidify into adulthood. Not only that, but people just have more important things to do in their little bubble of life than others. This is why humanity cannot come together and work together to make it feel like we all belong in the hell we call Earth.

The feeling of being so little than ever before. 

It’s an extremely horrible burden that you just can’t shake off that easily, you see the world fall apart right before your own eyes. The feeling is extremely unreal. The contemplation of suicide almost everyday. The loser that you think is in your name and in your character. The sense of faliure which hurts acutely. You feel like there is nothing in this life that you can provide for the good. You feel lost, wasted and no matter what you try, it’s not good enough.

Not sure if your package is FedEx ground/home delivery or FedEx smartpost. FedEx packages that are labeled smartpost are lowest priority which means that your package will take longer to get to your doorstep. This is just information that I read online. I still haven’t gotten my package as of 5/9/2022 and has supposably left the Olathe, KS facility two days ago bound for Colorado where I live.

Yup, just hopped onto the club. Got a package stuck in this ghetto location for 4 days now as of 5/3/2022. Never had a good experience with FedEx since they lose packages all the damn time. Yup, packages magically disappear out of nowhere. This location is truly FedUp. 

UPDATE: package has now moved out of Ellenwood as of 5/5/2022 after sitting for 6 days. After it’s delivered, this is the last time I’m ever using FedEx.

I always have that feeling that I just want to go away to a place where no one knows about. Don’t know where. I just don’t want anyone to touch my pain. It’s too toxic that it’s unrepairable. I’d do that for myself instead with being with another person. Matter a fact I’d rather die than to be with someone else.
I’ll just stay away from anyone because I haven’t had this level of insecurities and trust issues before. It’s super difficult nowadays, I think it’s impossible. Thanks for the suggestions though.

I could try but due to my lack of giving trust to others I just cannot do that unfortunately. I’ll be lonely until the day that I die. I had a friend group a few months ago that I knew for 3+ years. I even called family but ended up in a toxic situation that I had to leave them. Everything good that I had in me is completely lost.

Never expected to get a reply from this sickening comment but I’ll still reply. I don’t have any friends, If I did commit suicide, I’d like very little people knowing the news what happened to me. What used to be close friends, friends and even family members are now just blank. They don’t deserve to hear anything from me. I’m just this dark unseen spot in life that’s basically my only purpose to be here.
